name: Queue Runner
author: enoky
description: Processes a WanGP queue file without the browser, and can shut the RunPod pod down when it is finished.

info_card.tagline: Run a Queue File, Then Shut Down
info_card.description: Give a queue.json or a queue .zip: it is processed on the server without the browser, and the pod can be stopped or terminated when the last task is done.
info_card.details: Completed tasks are remembered, so an interrupted queue continues where it stopped.
